srs: The clinic booking system records Patient, Appointment, BookingService, and Clinician; each has an id attribute. Each Patient can have zero or more Appointment records, and each Appointment belongs to exactly one Patient. Each Appointment uses exactly one BookingService, and each BookingService serves zero or more Appointment records. Each BookingService manages one or more Clinician records by composition, and each Clinician belongs to exactly one BookingService. Each Patient can reference zero or more Clinician records, and each Clinician can be referenced by zero or more Patient records.
